tei:div.tei:p: phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon la/ sems bskyed sdom chog brgyud 'debs/ rang gi snying ga'i= 'di dang*/ 'gugs pa bcas la/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i= kha sgyur/ skyabs sems yan brgyad/ lha skyed / rdo rje de bzhin nyid kyi= ra las rakta= nas/ 'og min gsang chen= las byang blang*/ stobs kyis sgrolaḥ bar 'og gi hūm̐ḥ tha bya ka= mdzad: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ sarba bignaṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bzla bsdu ldang*/ sa chog cha gsum/ sa chog rgyal tho/ sri mnan/ sgo byang*/ ma tram bsgral/ chag chag ki la ya/ lha tshom dbus/ de rgyab lnga/ de rgyab/ dbus mdun g.yas g.yon bcas su bzhi re/ phyogs bcur bzhi bcu/ sgo bzhi/ de rgyab bcu gnyis/ mchod rlabs/ lha skyed gong ltar/ snying ga= nas/ pra tītstsha hoḥ las byang mchod pa/ rakta'i tshab/ hūm̐/ dngos grub= rtsa gsum bstod pa/ hūm̐ḥ sgeg pa= bsnyen pa/ rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol: khyed rnams mchod dang snyen pa'i don: nangs par dkyil 'khor bri 'tshal bsaḥ thugs kyis dgongs te gnang bar mdzod/ badzrod tiṣṭha lhanaḥ bum sta/ slob ma sta gon/ thig tshon bcas/ ༈ rgyan bkod nyin/ las byang 'thab lugs gong ltar/ bzlas pa rab gnas bsnyen/ bdag 'jug rab gnas/ rgyan bkod/ gsol ka tshogs bcas/ ༈ dngos gzhi nyin bdun la/ sngon 'gro ngag 'don/ sems bskyed/ las byang gong ltar/ phyi chog mnyam 'don/ bum sgrub/ mchod phreng*/ gsol 78) ka na raka skong bshags/ tshogs/ rdo rje'i thol glu/ bdag 'jug drang lhag gsol ka bkyag bskul chad brtan bro/ mchod bstod bshags/ rten bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis/ nyulle bskrad byin 'bebs bcas/ ༈ nyin brgyad par/ las byang*/ gsol ka tshogs/ bskul pa/ dngos grub bsnyen/ bskrad/ byin/ dngos grub blang*/ dbang*/ ༈ sbyin sreg la/ tshig bdun/ 'dzam gling*/ rdor dril byin rlabs/ mchod rlabs rol/ sman gtor rakta'i sngags/ sreg rdzas byin rlabs/ me thab byin rlabs/ dzwa la=

rol/ hūm̐ hūm̐= rol/ thabs kyi= hūm̐/ dad pa= bum gdangs/ rol/ dzaḥhūṃ= shabda= rol/ ji ltar= nas/ gsol bar gyur/ agne/ bdun/ sngags ring rol/ de 'dra gsum/ oṃ agne de ba ri ṣi ha bya ka= bya di bya= bdag cag= rol/ de 'dra bcu/ tshangs pa nas/ ti ra baṃ= yan/ spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ḥ srid pa'i phur bu= bum gdangs/ rol ring*/ rtsa sngags bsnyen/ lha tshom thab tu 'bul/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dābti tsakra= nas/ lnga btegs/ 'don lugs gzhung gsal ltar/ bla med= shabda= rol/ dkyil 'khor= rtsa sngags/ bdun/ badzra agne= len gcig rol/ de 'dra gsum/ hūṃḥ gti mug= rtsa gdangs/ rtsa sngags bcu/ bdag dang= rol/ de 'dra brgya rtsa/ dgangs blug nyer gcig rol gsum/ ye shes me dang = lha tshogs= de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// badzra wast+ra= rol/ tam bu= rol/ rdo rje'i= nas/ zhi bar gyur/ bar/ rtsa sngags/ gsham sbyar nyer gcig arghaṃ= 79) rol/ sgeg pa= tshig bzhi/ ma rnyed yongs su= yig brgya/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= rol ring*/ gzhal yas= thim par gyur/ oṃ agne= len gcig sngags ring*/ rol/ wast+ra= rol/ tambu= rol/ oṃ agne= me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma= rnal 'byor= rol/ yig brgya/ badzra muḥ rnam par gyur/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsolaḥ phun sum tshogs pa= khrom dbang*/ drang lhag gsol bkyag man/ bshags pa yan/ oṃḥ khyod kyi sems can= bsdu ldang phyi nang gsang mtshams bsdu/ mar me'i smon lam/ las byang bsngo shis/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs= phun sum tshogs pa= bkra shis dga' bskor bcas/ 80) sa chog la/ cha gsum/ sa lha'i dkar gtor/ a ka ro= rgyal ba shākya seng ge yi// bdud sde mngon par bcom pa'i tshe// dbang gyur sa yi lha mo khyod// gtor ma bzhes la sa 'di bslang*/

'o/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ sogs/ mdzodaḥ badzra muḥ yi dam rtsa sngags brgya/ oṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭaḥ lan gsum gyis thal mo sar bsnun/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3 haṃ/ dge'o//
